rules.confirmation_gate: All six current confirmation summaries completed and consistent before any final input preparation/evaluation
rules.selection: Only development validation and measured costs select routes; both seeds are reported, never choose with final test
rules.label_read: Original aligned displacement/stress are read only after prediction for each case; labels are excluded from model input
rules.metrics: All original node physical U-vector relative L2/RMS/max mm and signed stress relative L2/RMSE/MAE MPa/top|stress|1% hotspot, mean/worst/percase
rules.stop: One frozen final validation, negative outcomes retained; no final-driven retraining or architecture tuning
rules.capability: Continuous query/BC/full10 kinematic proxy checks are separate bounded TRAIN diagnostics, not asserted by nodal prediction

selection_basis: All six confirmations complete. FNO is main candidate: lower joint endpoint U/S and stable across two seeds; MLP retained as inexpensive pointwise control. No final label consulted. BC-role grid replay records descriptor attenuation without causal attribution. GINO deferred as separate structural research rather than required before this validation.
